Tropical Pineapple Smoothie
By: Simmer + Sauce
Published: Thursday, June 13, 2019 - 12:26pm

Ingredients




1 cup, fresh pineapple, core removed, roughly chopped
1 teaspoon flaxseeds
1 teaspoon agave
1/2 cup coconut milk
1/2 cup oat milk
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups ice

Preparation

1 In a kitchen blender add the pineapple, flaxseeds, agave, coconut milk, oat milk, vanilla extract and ice. Blend on high for 60 seconds. Pour into a glass and serve right away.

About

A simple dairy-free tropical pineapple smoothie for summer.
